data.rootRule: one noncheck root per trajectory, cp-only, abs(top)<=250, ply>=16, nearest offset24; exclude old positions/mirrors and training q nodes

quality.union: all variants AND both node budgets per root; restricted MultiPV

fixedDepth.timing: sequential, rotated order, no other jobs; internal elapsed excludes model/process startup

matches.adjudication: terminal or repetition only; move cap unresolved

statistics: paired trajectory bootstrap 5000 replicates; no test tuning, no Elo; same opening families are not unseen-family generalization
